title: A New Bridge
text:
The city council has approved plans for a new bridge across the river. The bridge will reduce traffic in the old town centre and provide a safer route for cyclists. Engineers expect construction to take about three years.

Some residents worry about the noise and the cost of the project. However, the mayor argues that the long-term benefits will outweigh these problems. Environmental groups have asked for extra trees to be planted along the riverbank.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what will the new bridge reduce?
options: Traffic in the old town centre

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do some residents worry about?
options: The noise and the cost of the project
The quality of the river water

questions.text: What can be inferred about the mayor's view of the project?
options: He believes the benefits will be worth the problems
He has no opinion about the project
He is against all new bridges

questions.text: What can be inferred about the environmental groups?
options: They are concerned about the project's impact on nature
They want the bridge cancelled entirely
They are paid by the city council

vocabulary.definition: to make something smaller or less in amount
people who live in a particular place
advantages or good results that something provides

paragraph_translations: Міська рада схвалила плани будівництва нового мосту через річку. Міст зменшить рух транспорту в старому центрі міста і забезпечить безпечніший маршрут для велосипедистів. Інженери очікують, що будівництво триватиме близько трьох років.

Деякі мешканці хвилюються через шум і вартість проєкту. Втім, мер стверджує, що довгострокові переваги переважать ці проблеми. Екологічні організації попросили висадити додаткові дерева вздовж берега річки.
